# Implementation

Implemented `median(numbers)` using a numerically sorted copy to preserve the input. Empty arrays return null; odd lengths return the middle value; even lengths return the mean of the two middle values. The mean avoids overflow when adding large finite values.

Verification: `node test.mjs` exited 0 and printed `PASS 04-median`.
